name: icc
description: Ice-cream-cone (massive scoop on a massless cone). Top-sector maximal cut = elliptic; the curve's j-function over the kinematic base does NOT lie on any genus-0 X₁(N) (non-congruence) → DE-transport mandatory (value-fittability class C).

maxcut.source: scoop maximal cut: inner massive bubble Källén λ(z,1,1)=z(z-4) × outer cone localization (z−w)²−4tw. Generic (w,t) ⇒ 4 distinct roots, j(w) not on Beauville list. Cf. de la Cruz–Vanhove (L_top).
